newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ HAS RECEIVED REQUEST FOR SUPPORT FROM THAILAND.
newsitem.headline: BOJ HAS RECEIVED REQUEST FOR SUPPORT FROM THAILAND.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) has received a request for support from Thailand and will give it serious consideration, Takashi Anzai, BOJ executive director, told reporters on Tuesday.
He declined to comment further on the request.
Asked whether there was a detailed request for support from the Thai central bank governor, Anzai said: "Of course there were such discussions. We have received a request."

He added, "We don't start considering something just because there's a request. We have been studying (the issue) for a long time. There are things that we can do depending on changes in situations. We have received the request and would like to consider it."
Thai Central Bank Governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi, BOJ Governor Yasuo Matsushita and Anzai met for about an hour over lunch on Tuesday.

Anzai quoted Chaiyawat as saying that he was able to achieve good results from the Monday meeting of several nations and international organisations, which pledged $16 billion in support for the troubled Thai economy.
